summary: E2E backend + frontend verification of the 4 new Feb 2026 features on Paras Reward: (1) Mall network cap flat 800, (2) Upfront/prepaid deposit selector 10/20/35/50% with paid_prc=upfront_prc pricing model 'v3_prepaid_deposit', (3) Admin SOFT delete (active=False + deleted_at), (4) Admin bank-redeem-limits config GET/PATCH with X-Admin-Pin + downstream enforcement. Backend pytest: 12 passed / 2 skipped (insufficient PRC for 35%/50% deposits — expected on live user) / 1 skipped (Task 4f — user hit lifetime redeem cap ₹2,500, unrelated pre-existing gate). Frontend: All upfront chips render with correct data-testids, 10% is default active, live pay-now/remaining values update correctly (15k/30k/52.5k/75k PRC on MRP 15,000). Admin Bank Redeem Limits card at /admin/settings-hub?tab=system saves successfully with toast, values persist after reload, restore-to-default confirmed.

minor.issue: Legacy MAX_WITHDRAWAL check at manual_bank_transfer.py:638-640 uses max(progressive, MAX_WITHDRAWAL) and fires BEFORE the new admin-configured max check. If an admin sets max ABOVE the legacy MAX_WITHDRAWAL (10,000), the legacy check will erroneously reject amounts within the admin range. Consider removing/rewiring the legacy check now that admin config is the source of truth.

Order of gates: `compute_lifetime_redeem_quota` (403) fires BEFORE admin cfg check, so users who hit the ₹2,500 lifetime cap will never see the admin-configured max error. Not a bug per se — but Task 4f cannot be verified on a user who has already hit lifetime cap.

issues: Old direct route /admin/system-settings renders a blank/loading page. Route was migrated to /admin/settings-hub?tab=system. Main agent used the old path in the review request — clarify in docs so future testers/main-agent land on the correct URL.

action_items: Consider removing the legacy MAX_WITHDRAWAL cap at manual_bank_transfer.py:638-640 so admin can raise the per-tx max above ₹10,000 without patching code.

Consider moving admin cfg min/max check BEFORE compute_lifetime_redeem_quota so admin-configured limits fire even for users who exhausted lifetime cap (or at least surface admin cfg error alongside the lifetime block).
Update review-request docs: admin System Settings is at `/admin/settings-hub?tab=system`, not `/admin/system-settings`.
critical_code_review_comments: get_user_network_cap() at paras_mall.py:325-336 correctly returns constant 800 — cleanest possible implementation; existing referral BFS code was already retired.

compute_pricing_breakdown() at paras_mall.py:93-140 validates upfront_percent against ALLOWED_UPFRONT_PERCENTS and defaults silently to 0.10 on mismatch (INSIDE the helper). The endpoint at book_product() (line 617-624) does the STRICT validation and raises HTTPException(400) with the exact required message — good separation.

book_product() at paras_mall.py:684-685 sets paid_prc=upfront_prc and remaining_prc=total_prc-upfront_prc — matches spec. pricing_breakdown snapshot is stored per-booking (immutable) so future MRP changes don't retro-affect existing bookings. Good.

admin_delete_product() at paras_mall.py:1344-1380 does a pure soft delete (active=False + deleted_at + deleted_reason) and returns success=true even when active_bookings_continuing > 0 — no more 'Cannot delete' error. Verified: DB row remains, listing filter (line 579-580 only_active=True default) hides it, active bookings remain mineable.

admin_bank_redeem_config.py:130-176 PATCH endpoint correctly gates on X-Admin-Pin header against os.environ.get('ADMIN_OPERATION_PIN') — no fallback default, so a missing env var will also 403 (fail-safe).
admin_bank_redeem_config.py:150-163 validates min<=max and (monthly>0 implies monthly>=min) — good defensive ordering check.

MINOR: manual_bank_transfer.py:645-679 admin cfg gate is wrapped in try/except that logs and continues on ANY exception (except HTTPException) — this fail-open policy means a bug in admin_bank_redeem_config.get_bank_redeem_config would silently bypass the gate. Consider narrowing the except clause to Motor/Mongo errors only.
MINOR: manual_bank_transfer.py:638-640 legacy MAX_WITHDRAWAL check fires BEFORE admin cfg — can silently cap admin-configured max at 10,000. Recommend removal (see action items).
